We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We need the molecule structure. No SMILES given. We have tools to get NMR spectra, but not directly structure. Perhaps we can retrieve carbon or proton shifts to infer? Might need to request carbon NMR spectra then count methyl signals (around 10-30 ppm). But we need the sample's molecule; maybe the system has a sample context. Could request carbon_nmr_spectra. That will give peaks; we can count methyl signals. However methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm. Could be overlapping. Safer to get proton NMR and count methyl singlets (0.9 ppm). But need to know integration.

Probably easiest: request carbon_nmr_spectra.
